applicability: Source citation resolution for ordinary admitted live-leaf curation before Git closeout.
conditions: The shared future-code owner captures the exact eligible working and new source bytes under the real leaf contract.
The same captured source and admission facts are rechecked before affected writes and publication.
exclusions: Taskless bootstrap retains its existing admitted committed-source behavior.
This is not a global filesystem lock.
Source movement after a successful knowledge batch may leave uniquely authored candidate work while publication refuses; it is not published success.
statement: Ordinary live-leaf curation resolves its source citations against the shared exact future-code capture and refuses moved inputs before affected writes or publication.
